entities.summary: Democracy Movement and Transition, a transformative movement in Maldives (2003–2008). Emerged from Indian military Operation Cactus foils a mercenary coup attempt against Gayoom and Nasir. Catalyzed Indian Ocean tsunami devastates the Maldives — 82 killed, 14 islands evacuated and Nasheed Presidency and Climate Activism.
